description: This file contains code for handling 'funds' resources via REST API, including creating, retrieving, updating funds in the Fineract system. It provides a handler class FundsResourceHandler with static methods to perform these operations using request/response specifications.

classes.name: FundsResourceHandler
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create, retrieve, update, and manage funds resources via REST API calls in testing context.

methods.name: createFund
methods.description: Creates a new fund with specified JSON data, request and response specifications.

methods.name: createFund
methods.description: Creates a new fund with a randomly generated name and external ID, using provided request and response specifications.

methods.name: retrieveAllFunds
methods.description: Retrieves all funds from the system, returning a list of FundsHelper objects.

methods.name: retrieveFund
methods.description: Retrieves a specific fund by ID in JSON format.

methods.name: updateFund
methods.description: Updates a fund's name and external ID by fund ID, returning the updated FundsHelper object.
